name: Project Gamma
description: A mobile application for iOS and Android providing real-time notifications and updates.
setup_instructions:
1. Clone the repository
2. Install dependencies: `npm install`
3. Install iOS dependencies: `cd ios && pod install && cd ..`
4. Copy config: `cp .env.example .env`
5. Start Metro: `npm start`
6. Run on iOS: `npm run ios` or Android: `npm run android`
onboarding_notes: Make sure you have Xcode (for iOS) and Android Studio (for Android) properly configured. Review the component architecture in the /docs folder.
